items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I went down to do a show in Miami with Elvis Presley, after Presley got out

ctx.x: -- ah -- and I broke up with a writer friend of mine, a very dear friend, but he called me and I know he couldn't get an interview, I sensed it. He was calling me in Vegas and we just got back, and Frank had left us in the Lounge in Vegas, I went down to do a show in Miami with Elvis Presley, after Presley got out --
